description: This file defines the Java class AssociateGroupsToCenterCommandHandler, which handles commands to associate groups to a center within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands through the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService, and is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: AssociateGroupsToCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands for associating groups with a center, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to associate groups to a center by invoking the corresponding method in the write platform service.
